_doc: Variant plan. A record = one passage + 4 Q&A. Tiers decide how many passages per framework row. Phases are cumulative: 'full' adds ids AFTER 'phase1' (e.g. tier A: ids 1-5 in phase1, ids 6-15 in full).

A.name: core + foundational + cognitive (mechanisms everything else builds on)

C.name: large grid blocks (many near-sibling rows already give variety)

pilot.note: 10 stratified rows per stage x 3 variants + 6 clusters. Evaluate quality and Pro usage here.

full.note: about 47k records in total (adds ids after phase1)
